micah.2.p1.b1.text: Woe to those who devise iniquity and plot evil on their beds! At morning’s light they accomplish it because the power is in their hands.

micah.2.p1.b2.text: They covet fields and seize them; they take away houses. They deprive a man of his home, a fellow man of his inheritance.

micah.2.p1.b3.text: I am planning against this nation a disaster from which you cannot free your necks.

micah.2.p1.b5.text: I will preach to you of wine and strong drink

micah.2.p1.b6.text: You drive the women of My people from their pleasant homes. You take away My blessing from their children forever.

micah.2.p1.b7.text: I will surely gather all of you, O Jacob; I will collect the remnant of Israel. … like sheep in a pen

micah.2.p1.b8.text: One who breaks open the way will go up before them … Their King will pass through before them, the LORD as their leader.
